pages.title: Skateshop
pages.text: Plays in the shop between races, where the prize money buys new gear. Every skater starts the tour with $100. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: The shopkeeper
pages.text: He sells nothing that leaves you short of the next entry fee: 'Nice try bud! Check your wallet!' Buy wheels while your skates are trashed and he says your priorities are a bit off.

pages.title: Price tag
pages.text: In 1994 the cartridge itself cost $59.95 in the US and 44.99 pounds in the UK.
